blocks.html: Robinsons Land Corporation (RLC) and the Bureau of Immigration (BI) have forged a solid partnership for Robinsons Malls to be the official venue partner of BI’s alien registration to be held at Robinsons Manila from January 2, 2023 to March 02, 2023.
The registration area in Robinsons Manila will be located at the mall’s second level, center atrium, and will be open from Monday to Friday, 9:00 am to 5:00 pm.

Pursuant to Republic Act (R.A.) No. 562 or the Alien Registration Act of 1950, all registered aliens are required to report in person to the Bureau within the first 60 days of every calendar year with the aim to strictly enforce compliance with the Immigration Law for the interest of national security, public safety and public order.

The Bureau also extends its services in its various District Offices located at Robinsons Ilocos, Robinsons Palawan, Robinsons GenSan and Robinsons Dasmarinas. The services include extension of temporary Visitor’s Visa (TVV), issuance of Emigration Clearance Certificate (ECC), special work permit (SWP), Provisional work permit (PWP), and Student Study permit (SSP), processing and payment of Annual Report, receiving of applications for change to or renewal of immigrant and non-immigrant visas, and receiving of application for Dual Citizenship.

Present during the signing of the Memorandum of Agreement are (L-R) Irving L. Wu, External Affairs and Operations Support Director, Joel S. Lumanlan, Vice President for Operations, Marketing and Business Development, Faraday D. Go, Executive Vice President, Robinsons Land Corporation (RLC), Atty. Norman G. Tansingco, Commissioner, Bureau of Immigration (BI), Rogelio D. Gevero Jr., BI OIC Deputy Commissioner and Atty. Jose Carlito Z. Licas, BI Chief, Alien Registration Division.
